infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: drukstech uses the microphone only for modules that record audio.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: drukstech uses the camera only for modules that take photos, scan QR codes, or control the torch.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: drukstech uses location only for modules that require GPS.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: drukstech uses motion sensors only for modules that require them.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow drukstech to use the camera for photos, QR codes and torch in enabled modules.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow drukstech to use the microphone if a module requires it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow drukstech to use location only in enabled modules.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow drukstech to record audio through enabled modules.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow drukstech to open the camera for photo modules.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow drukstech to use photos selected by enabled modules.
